text: Who should pay on a first date? Let's settle this one and for all. This is one of the most common questions guys ask. And honestly, the answer is simple. If you want to be effective on your dates, you, the man, should pay. Now I know some men will start saying, this is not fair. What about feminism and equal rights? We both have to work and earn money. Guys, welcome to the real life. Yes, there are double standards. You can insist she pays half, or only for what she ordered. But be prepared. A lot of your dates won't go anywhere after that. There is fairness, and then there is effectiveness. If your goal is to actually move things forward, connection, chemistry, kisses, intimacy, then you pay. In the beginning, the initiative comes from you. You ask her out, you pick the place, and you take care of the bill. Simple as that. Now, what if you can't afford it? Then honestly, your problem isn't dating, it's your finances. If you can't cover a couple of coffees or drinks, you need to work on your income, and your growth as a man. Postpone dating until you can afford it. Or stick to low-cost options like a walk in the park. Just understand, they are usually less effective than sitting together in a cozy bar, relaxed with a drink. And what if she insists on paying for herself? It happens. Just say, let me get it this time. If you want, you can pay next time. If she agrees, great. You showed you're a gentleman, and you also planted the seed of a second date. If she still insists, let her. You are there to enjoy yourself, not to argue. Bottom line, if you want your dates to be more successful, the bill should be on you. You are having a good time too, and paying is simply a part of making the date work.
